"""Configuration: configs/defaults.yaml overlaid by configs/<client>.yaml (top-level keys).

Client files come in two schemas (docs/adr/0007-config-schema-v2.md). Schema 1 is flat: every key is
a top-level service key. Schema 2 (`schema: 2`) groups the same keys into sections and is flattened
on load, so the rest of the service only ever sees the flat keys.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import yaml

APP_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CONFIG_DIR = APP_DIR / "configs"
DATA_DIR = APP_DIR / "data"
OUT_DIR = APP_DIR / "out"

# Schema 2: section -> the flat keys it may hold. `name` and `schema` stay at the top level.
V2_SECTIONS = {
    "service": ("interval_minutes", "tz", "operating_hours"),
    "targets": ("sla", "sla_target", "attainment_basis"),
    "staffing": ("queueing", "patience_sec", "occupancy_cap", "aht_smoothing"),
    "scheduling": ("weekly_hours", "max_consecutive_days", "break", "min_cover", "cross_skill_weight"),
}


def _flatten_v2(doc: dict) -> dict:
    """A schema-2 client file -> flat top-level keys. An unknown section or a key in the wrong
    section is an error rather than a silent fall-back to the default."""
    flat = {}
    for key, value in doc.items():
        if key == "schema":
            continue
        if key == "name":
            flat["name"] = value
            continue
        if key not in V2_SECTIONS:
            raise SystemExit(f"config schema 2: unknown section '{key}'")
        for k, v in (value or {}).items():
            if k not in V2_SECTIONS[key]:
                raise SystemExit(f"config schema 2: '{k}' does not belong in section '{key}'")
            flat[k] = v
    return flat


def load_config(client: str) -> dict:
    defaults = yaml.safe_load((CONFIG_DIR / "defaults.yaml").read_text())
    client_file = CONFIG_DIR / f"{client}.yaml"
    if not client_file.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown client '{client}': no {client_file.relative_to(APP_DIR)}")
    doc = yaml.safe_load(client_file.read_text()) or {}
    if doc.get("schema") == 2:
        doc = _flatten_v2(doc)
    elif "schema" in doc:
        raise SystemExit(f"{client_file.relative_to(APP_DIR)}: unsupported config schema {doc['schema']!r}")
    cfg = dict(defaults)
    cfg.update(doc)
    cfg["client"] = client
    return cfg
"""Ingest: a client's weekly demand file -> canonical intervals (UTC, client grain).

Two input layouts are supported in data/<client>/:
  week_<ISO>.csv    canonical (client, queue, interval_start_utc, interval_minutes, volume, aht_sec)
  export_<ISO>.csv  a client's own local-time export (interval_start_local, ..., queue, volume, aht_sec),
                    kept from Fabrikam's first onboarding; assumed to be at the client's configured grain.

The result has one row per queue per interval of the ISO week in the client's timezone, at the
client's configured grain, sorted by interval then queue.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd

from wfm.config import DATA_DIR

QUEUES = ("priority", "standard")   # service default; a client config may list its own under `queues`


def queues_for(cfg: dict) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(cfg.get("queues") or QUEUES)


def iso_week_monday(week: str) -> date:
    """'2026-W44' -> Monday 2026-10-26."""
    year, wk = week.split("-W")
    return date.fromisocalendar(int(year), int(wk), 1)


def local_days(week: str, tz: str) -> list[date]:
    mon = iso_week_monday(week)
    return [mon + timedelta(days=i) for i in range(7)]


def _read_canonical(path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    df["interval_start_utc"] = pd.to_datetime(df["interval_start_utc"], utc=True)
    return df[["queue", "interval_start_utc", "volume", "aht_sec"]]


# Fabrikam's re-sent 2025 exports have no offset column. US Eastern offset in effect from each DST
# change date (local) on; good enough for Fabrikam's weeks (WFM-204).
FABRIKAM_OFFSETS = {"2025-03-09": "-04:00", "2025-11-02": "-05:00", "2026-03-08": "-04:00", "2026-11-01": "-05:00"}


def _fixed_offsets(local: pd.Series, table: dict[str, str]) -> pd.Series:
    """UTC from local wall-clock labels and a {change date: offset} table."""
    keys = sorted(table)
    off = [table[max([k for k in keys if k <= d] or keys[:1])] for d in local.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")]
    return pd.to_datetime(local.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") + pd.Series(off, index=local.index),
                          format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M%z", utc=True)


def week_grid(week: str, tz: str, grain_min: int) -> pd.DatetimeIndex:
    """Every interval start (UTC) of the ISO week in the client's timezone: Monday 00:00 local to the
    next Monday 00:00 local, elapsed. A DST change makes the week 167 or 169 hours long."""
    z = ZoneInfo(tz)
    mon = iso_week_monday(week)
    nxt = mon + timedelta(days=7)
    start = pd.Timestamp(datetime(mon.year, mon.month, mon.day, tzinfo=z)).tz_convert("UTC")
    end = pd.Timestamp(datetime(nxt.year, nxt.month, nxt.day, tzinfo=z)).tz_convert("UTC")
    return pd.date_range(start, end, freq=f"{grain_min}min", inclusive="left")


def _read_export(path, cfg: dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    local = pd.to_datetime(df["interval_start_local"])
    if "utc_offset" in df:
        # The offset in effect on each row is authoritative (Northwind): the wall-clock label is
        # ambiguous in the repeated hour of a DST fall-back and absent in a spring-forward.
        df["interval_start_utc"] = pd.to_datetime(local.dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") + df["utc_offset"].astype(str).str.strip(),
                                                  format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M%z", utc=True)
    elif cfg["client"] == "fabrikam":   # WFM-204: re-sent 2025 exports have no offset column
        df["interval_start_utc"] = _fixed_offsets(local, FABRIKAM_OFFSETS)
    else:
        df["interval_start_utc"] = local.dt.tz_localize(cfg["tz"]).dt.tz_convert("UTC")
    return df[["queue", "interval_start_utc", "volume", "aht_sec"]]


def _resample(df: pd.DataFrame, grain_min: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Aggregate to the configured grain: volume summed, AHT volume-weighted."""
    df = df.copy()
    df["interval_start_utc"] = df["interval_start_utc"].dt.floor(f"{grain_min}min")
    df["_w"] = df["volume"] * df["aht_sec"]
    g = df.groupby(["queue", "interval_start_utc"], sort=True).agg(
        volume=("volume", "sum"), _w=("_w", "sum"), aht_mean=("aht_sec", "mean")).reset_index()
    g["aht_sec"] = (g["_w"] / g["volume"]).where(g["volume"] > 0, g["aht_mean"])
    return g[["queue", "interval_start_utc", "volume", "aht_sec"]]


def load_week(cfg: dict, week: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    client = cfg["client"]
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    canon = DATA_DIR / client / f"week_{week}.csv"
    export = DATA_DIR / client / f"export_{week}.csv"
    full_week = False
    if canon.exists():
        df = _read_canonical(canon)
    elif export.exists():
        df = _read_export(export, cfg)
        full_week = "utc_offset" in pd.read_csv(export, nrows=0).columns
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"no data for {client} {week}: expected {canon} or {export}")

    df = _resample(df, grain)   # also snaps off-grid labels (e.g. a 10:01 row) onto their interval
    if full_week:
        # Exports with an explicit offset: the grid is the ISO week itself (local Monday to Monday,
        # elapsed), whatever rows the export happens to carry; rows outside the week are dropped.
        grid = week_grid(week, cfg["tz"], grain)
        df = df[df["interval_start_utc"].isin(grid)]
    else:
        grid = pd.DatetimeIndex(sorted(df["interval_start_utc"].unique()))   # the week as the data delivers it
    frames = []
    for q in queues_for(cfg):
        part = df[df["queue"] == q].set_index("interval_start_utc").reindex(grid)
        part["queue"] = q
        part["volume"] = part["volume"].fillna(0.0)
        part["aht_sec"] = part["aht_sec"].fillna(part["aht_sec"].mean())
        frames.append(part.rename_axis("interval_start_utc").reset_index())
    out = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    out["client"] = client
    out["interval_minutes"] = grain
    out = out.sort_values(["interval_start_utc", "queue"], kind="stable").reset_index(drop=True)
    return out[["client", "queue", "interval_start_utc", "interval_minutes", "volume", "aht_sec"]]

from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd

from vendor.qlib import required_agents as qlib_required
from wfm.staffing.erlang import required_agents


def _handle_time(g: pd.DataFrame, mode: str) -> pd.Series:

    loc = t.astimezone(ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"]))

    return lo <= h < hi

    """Append a `required` column to the canonical intervals frame.

    The occupancy cap (`occupancy_cap`) is applied in the staffing call (WFM-212). Handle time follows
    `aht_smoothing`: `queue_mean` uses the queue's mean AHT over intervals with volume (WFM-198);
    `interval` uses each interval's own AHT. With `queue_hours` set, intervals outside a queue's
    operating hours need no staff.

    cap = cfg.get("occupancy_cap")
    mode = cfg.get("aht_smoothing", "queue_mean")
    out = df.copy()
    out["required"] = 0
    for q, g in out.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        sla = cfg["sla"][q]

            ahts = [float(a) for a in g["aht_sec"]]
        else:
            # per-interval AHT is too noisy at low volume; use the smoothed queue AHT (WFM-198)

        req = [model(v, interval_sec, aht, sla["target"], sla["seconds"], cap) for v, aht in zip(g["volume"], ahts)]
        if cfg.get("queue_hours"):
            req = [r if in_hours(t, cfg, q) else 0 for r, t in zip(req, g["interval_start_utc"])]
        out.loc[g.index, "required"] = req
    out.attrs["occupancy_cap"] = cap
    return out

    return 0.0 if n <= 0 else a / n


def required_agents(
    volume: float,
    interval_sec: float,
    aht_sec: float,
    sl_target: float,
    target_sec: float,
    occupancy_cap: float | None = None,
    max_agents: int = 2000,
) -> int:
    """Smallest n meeting the service-level target and (if given) the occupancy cap."""
    a = traffic_intensity(volume, interval_sec, aht_sec)
    if a <= 0:
        return 0
    n = max(1, math.ceil(a))
    while n < max_agents:
        ok_sl = service_level(a, n, aht_sec, target_sec) >= sl_target
        ok_occ = occupancy_cap is None or occupancy(a, n) <= occupancy_cap
        if ok_sl and ok_occ:
            return n
        n += 1
    return n


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Standard check: 1000 calls/hour, AHT 180 s, 80/20 -> 56 agents
    n = required_agents(volume=1000, interval_sec=3600, aht_sec=180, sl_target=0.80, target_sec=20)
    a = traffic_intensity(1000, 3600, 180)
    print(f"A={a:.2f} Erlangs, required={n}, SL={service_level(a, n, 180, 20):.3f}, "
          f"ASA={asa(a, n, 180):.1f}s, occ={occupancy(a, n):.3f}")
    assert n == 56, n
    # With an occupancy cap the answer can only go up
    n2 = required_agents(1000, 3600, 180, 0.80, 20, occupancy_cap=0.85)
    assert n2 >= n
    print("ok")
"""Minimum cover: queues that need a number of agents on shift whatever the volume.

A client config names them under `min_cover`, with the local hours the floor applies:

    min_cover:
      chat: {agents: 2, hours: [20, 24]}

The scheduler raises each interval's requirement on the queue to the floor; the evaluator reports
intervals below it as `min_cover` violations.

Cross-skilled cover (PR #31). An agent on shift on another queue who also holds the floor queue's
skill counts `cross_skill_weight` of an agent toward the floor (service default 0.5: a voice agent
with the chat skill picks up chats between calls). The weight applies to the floor only; required
agents from the staffing model are always counted on the queue itself.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


def floor(queue: str, t: datetime, cfg: dict) -> int:
    """Agents the floor asks for on `queue` in the interval starting at `t` (0 if none applies)."""
    rule = (cfg.get("min_cover") or {}).get(queue)
    if not rule:
        return 0
    loc = t.astimezone(ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"]))
    h = loc.hour + loc.minute / 60
    lo, hi = rule.get("hours", cfg["operating_hours"])
    return int(rule["agents"]) if lo <= h < hi else 0


def weight(cfg: dict) -> float:
    return float(cfg.get("cross_skill_weight", 0.0))


def cover(on_queue: float, cross_skilled: float, cfg: dict) -> float:
    """Cover counted toward a floor: agents on the queue plus weighted cross-skilled agents elsewhere."""
    return on_queue + weight(cfg) * cross_skilled


def uncovered(required: int, floor_need: int, on_queue: float, cross_skilled: float, cfg: dict) -> float:
    """What the interval still lacks: the staffing requirement (agents on the queue) or the floor
    (cover as above), whichever is short by more."""
    return max(0.0, required - on_queue, floor_need - cover(on_queue, cross_skilled, cfg))
"""Shift templates: local wall-clock segments on one local day; none crosses local midnight."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Template:
    id: str
    segments: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]  # (start_hour, end_hour) local, end may be 24
    eligibility: str = "all"               # "all" or a contract code

    @property
    def hours(self) -> float:
        return float(sum(e - s for s, e in self.segments))

    @property
    def is_split(self) -> bool:
        return len(self.segments) > 1

    def segments_utc(self, day: date, tz: str) -> list[tuple[datetime, datetime]]:
        """Local wall-clock segments on `day` -> UTC datetimes."""
        z = ZoneInfo(tz)
        midnight = datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, tzinfo=z)
        return [((midnight + timedelta(hours=s)).astimezone(timezone.utc),
                 (midnight + timedelta(hours=e)).astimezone(timezone.utc)) for s, e in self.segments]


TEMPLATES: list[Template] = [
    Template("E8", ((6, 14),)),
    Template("D8", ((9, 17),)),
    Template("L8", ((13, 21),)),
    Template("N8", ((16, 24),)),
    Template("P6a", ((7, 13),)),
    Template("P6b", ((15, 21),)),
    Template("P4", ((10, 14),)),
    Template("S44", ((8, 12), (16, 20)), eligibility="all"),
]


def client_templates(cfg: dict) -> list[Template]:
    """A client's own templates (`extra_templates` in its config), used alongside the service set:

        extra_templates:
          - {id: C8-07, segments: [[7, 15]]}            # local hours, end may be 24
          - {id: X44, segments: [[8, 12], [17, 21]], eligibility: PT}

    Like the service templates they are local wall-clock and may not cross local midnight."""
    out = []
    for spec in cfg.get("extra_templates") or []:
        segs = tuple((int(s), int(e)) for s, e in spec["segments"])
        if any(not (0 <= s < e <= 24) for s, e in segs) or any(a[1] > b[0] for a, b in zip(segs, segs[1:])):
            raise SystemExit(f"extra_templates: {spec['id']}: segments must be ordered local hours within one day")
        out.append(Template(str(spec["id"]), segs, spec.get("eligibility", "all")))
    return out


def templates_for(cfg: dict) -> list[Template]:
    """Templates (service set plus the client's `extra_templates`) that fit inside the client's local
    operating hours."""
    open_h, close_h = cfg["operating_hours"]
    return [t for t in TEMPLATES + client_templates(cfg) if all(open_h <= s and e <= close_h for s, e in t.segments)]


def eligible(template: Template, contract: str) -> bool:
    return template.eligibility == "all" or template.eligibility == contract
"""Agents: data/agents/<client>.csv -> list of Agent."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

import pandas as pd

from wfm.config import DATA_DIR


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Agent:
    agent_id: str
    contract: str            # "FT" | "PT"
    skills: frozenset[str]   # queues the agent may serve


def load_agents(client: str) -> list[Agent]:
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_DIR / "agents" / f"{client}.csv", dtype=str)
    return [Agent(r.agent_id, r.contract, frozenset(r.skills.split(";"))) for r in df.itertuples(index=False)]

"""Evaluate a schedule.csv against the required curve: attainment, hours, constraint audit.

A convenience for engineers. Contractual evaluation is performed independently against each
client's SOW.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd

from wfm import constraints
from wfm.roster import Agent
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours


def _parse(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        df[c] = pd.to_datetime(df[c], utc=True)
    df["break_minutes"] = df["break_minutes"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return df


def coverage(sched: pd.DataFrame, grid, grain_min: int, skills: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """Per queue per interval: gross agents on queue, agents on break (overlapping the slot), and
    agents on shift on another queue who hold this queue's skill (`skills`: agent_id -> skills)."""
    gross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    on_break = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    cross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain_min)
    skills = skills or {}
    for r in sched.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                gross[r.queue][t] += 1
                for q in skills.get(r.agent_id, ()):
                    if q != r.queue:
                        cross[q][t] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    on_break[r.queue][t] += 1
    return gross, on_break, cross


def evaluate(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], week: str) -> dict:
    sched = _parse(sched)
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    gross, on_break, cross = coverage(sched, grid, grain, {a.agent_id: a.skills for a in agents})
    h = grain / 60.0
    basis = cfg.get("attainment_basis", "service_level")

    # `attainment_intervals`: `volume` (service default) counts intervals with volume; `operating`
    # counts every interval inside the queue's operating hours (`queue_hours` / `operating_hours`).
    operating = cfg.get("attainment_intervals", "volume") == "operating"
    sla, under, over = {}, 0.0, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            if operating:
                if not in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                    under += max(0, r.required - (gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc])) * h
                    continue
            elif r.volume <= 0:
                continue
            tot += 1
            scheduled = gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc]
            if basis == "coverage":   # PR #47: scheduled coverage of the requirement, capped at 1
                met += min(1.0, scheduled / r.required) if r.required else 1.0
            elif scheduled >= r.required:
                met += 1
            under += max(0, r.required - scheduled) * h
            over += max(0, scheduled - r.required) * h
        sla[q] = round(met / tot, 3) if tot else 1.0

    hours = float(((sched["segment_end_utc"] - sched["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    extra = {}
    if cfg.get("max_hours_ratio") is not None:
        req_hours = float(req["required"].sum()) * h
        extra = {"required_hours": round(req_hours, 1),
                 "hours_ratio": round(hours / req_hours, 4) if req_hours else None,
                 "max_hours_ratio": cfg["max_hours_ratio"]}
    return {
        "client": cfg["client"], "week": week, "intervals": len(grid),
        "sla": sla, "meets_target": all(v >= cfg["sla_target"] for v in sla.values()),
        "scheduled_hours": round(hours, 1),
        "understaffed_interval_hours": round(under, 1), "overstaffed_interval_hours": round(over, 1),
        "agents_scheduled": int(sched["agent_id"].nunique()),
        **extra,
        "violations": {**audit(sched, cfg, agents), "min_cover": floor_gaps(gross, cross, grid, cfg),
                       **contract_audit(sched, req, cfg, agents, gross)},
    }


def floor_gaps(gross: dict, cross: dict, grid, cfg: dict) -> int:
    """Intervals where a `min_cover` queue has less cover than its floor (see wfm/constraints.py)."""
    return sum(1 for q in (cfg.get("min_cover") or {}) for t in grid
               if constraints.cover(gross[q][t], cross[q][t], cfg) < constraints.floor(q, t, cfg))


def audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count violations of the service's standard rules per agent."""
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    v = {"weekly_hours": 0, "consecutive_days": 0, "skill_match": 0, "no_overlap": 0}
    for aid, g in sched.groupby("agent_id"):
        a = by_id.get(aid)
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        hours = ((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum()
        if a is None or hours > cfg["weekly_hours"][a.contract] + 1e-9:
            v["weekly_hours"] += 1
        if a is not None and any(q not in a.skills for q in g["queue"]):
            v["skill_match"] += 1
        ends = g["segment_end_utc"].shift(1)
        if (g["segment_start_utc"] < ends).any():
            v["no_overlap"] += 1
        days = sorted({t.astimezone(z).date() for t in g["segment_start_utc"]})
        run = 1
        for d1, d2 in zip(days, days[1:]):
            run = run + 1 if (d2 - d1).days == 1 else 1
            if run > cfg["max_consecutive_days"]:
                v["consecutive_days"] += 1
                break
    return v


def _shifts(sched: pd.DataFrame, z: ZoneInfo) -> list[dict]:
    """Segments grouped into shifts: one shift per agent per local day."""
    out = []
    for (aid, day), g in sched.groupby([sched["agent_id"], sched["segment_start_utc"].map(lambda t: t.astimezone(z).date())]):
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        out.append({"agent_id": aid, "day": day, "queue": g["queue"].iloc[0],
                    "start": g["segment_start_utc"].iloc[0], "end": g["segment_end_utc"].iloc[-1],
                    "segments": list(zip(g["segment_start_utc"], g["segment_end_utc"])),
                    "hours": float((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds().sum() / 3600),
                    "breaks": [(b, int(m)) for b, m in zip(g["break_start_utc"], g["break_minutes"]) if m and pd.notna(b)]})
    return out


def contract_audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, req: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], gross: dict) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Rules from the newer contracts, audited only for clients whose config turns them on:
    `min_rest_hours` (rest), `split_contracts` (split_shift), `break.placement: surplus` (breaks:
    count, length, window, and the interval with the largest gross surplus)."""
    v: dict[str, int] = {}
    if sched.empty:
        return v
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    shifts = _shifts(sched, z)
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    if cfg.get("min_rest_hours"):
        rest = timedelta(hours=float(cfg["min_rest_hours"]))
        v["rest"] = 0
        for aid in {s["agent_id"] for s in shifts}:
            mine = sorted((s for s in shifts if s["agent_id"] == aid), key=lambda s: s["start"])
            v["rest"] += sum(1 for a, b in zip(mine, mine[1:]) if b["start"] - a["end"] < rest)
    if cfg.get("split_contracts") is not None:
        ok = set(cfg["split_contracts"])
        v["split_shift"] = sum(1 for s in shifts if len(s["segments"]) > 1
                               and (s["agent_id"] not in by_id or by_id[s["agent_id"]].contract not in ok))
    rule = cfg.get("break") or {}
    if rule.get("placement") == "surplus":
        grain = timedelta(minutes=cfg["interval_minutes"])
        required = {(r.queue, r.interval_start_utc): int(r.required) for r in req.itertuples(index=False)}
        lo, hi = (timedelta(hours=x) for x in rule["window_hours"])
        length = timedelta(minutes=rule["minutes"])
        bad = 0
        for s in shifts:
            if s["hours"] < rule["min_shift_hours"]:
                bad += bool(s["breaks"])
                continue
            if len(s["breaks"]) != 1 or s["breaks"][0][1] != rule["minutes"]:
                bad += 1
                continue
            b = s["breaks"][0][0]
            if not (s["start"] + lo <= b <= s["start"] + hi) or not any(a <= b and b + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"]):
                bad += 1
                continue
            slot = [t for t in required if t[0] == s["queue"] and t[1] <= b < t[1] + grain]
            if not slot or b + length > slot[0][1] + grain:
                bad += 1
                continue
            q = s["queue"]
            window = [t for (qq, t) in required if qq == q and s["start"] + lo <= t <= s["start"] + hi
                      and any(a <= t and t + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"])]
            surplus = lambda t: gross[q][t] - required[(q, t)]
            if window and surplus(slot[0][1]) < max(surplus(t) for t in window):
                bad += 1
        v["breaks"] = bad
    return v
"""Weekly reconciliation report (Northwind SOW §3) and the exceptions file (SOW §2.7).

Written by `run` for clients whose config sets `reconciliation`:

    reconciliation:
      handover: docs/clients/northwind.md   # handover note: sections `## Handover note` and `## Files changed`

Every figure is recomputed here from the run's own required curve and schedule (not copied from the
evaluator), with the SOW definitions: attainment over each queue's operating intervals, met when the
agents on the queue net of breaks are at least the Erlang C requirement; hours elapsed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from wfm.config import APP_DIR
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours

KEYS = ("intervals_in_week", "sla_attainment_priority", "sla_attainment_standard", "sla_attainment_vip",
        "scheduled_hours_total", "required_hours_total", "understaffed_interval_hours", "agents_scheduled",
        "files_changed")


def figures(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict) -> dict:
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain)
    h = grain / 60.0
    s = sched.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        s[c] = pd.to_datetime(s[c], utc=True)
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    net = defaultdict(int)
    for r in s.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                net[(r.queue, t)] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and pd.notna(r.break_start_utc) and \
                        r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    net[(r.queue, t)] -= 1
    attainment, under = {}, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            n = net[(q, r.interval_start_utc)]
            under += max(0, int(r.required) - n) * h
            if in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                tot += 1
                met += n >= int(r.required)
        attainment[q] = met / tot if tot else 1.0
    hours = float(((s["segment_end_utc"] - s["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    return {"intervals": len(grid), "attainment": attainment, "scheduled_hours": hours,
            "required_hours": float(req["required"].sum()) * h, "understaffed_hours": under,
            "agents": int(s["agent_id"].nunique())}


def _handover(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """(handover note markdown, files changed) from the client's handover document."""
    text = path.read_text()
    note = re.search(r"^## Handover note\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    files = re.search(r"^## Files changed\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    paths = re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)`", files.group(1), re.M) if files else []
    return (note.group(1).strip() if note else ""), paths


def _f3(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.3f}"


def write(out: Path, cfg: dict, week: str, req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    spec = cfg.get("reconciliation") or {}
    f = figures(req, sched, cfg)
    note, files = _handover(APP_DIR / spec["handover"]) if spec.get("handover") else ("", [])
    att = f["attainment"]
    values = {
        "intervals_in_week": str(f["intervals"]),
        **{f"sla_attainment_{q}": _f3(att.get(q, float("nan"))) for q in ("priority", "standard", "vip")},
        "scheduled_hours_total": f"{f['scheduled_hours']:.1f}",
        "required_hours_total": f"{f['required_hours']:.1f}",
        "understaffed_interval_hours": f"{f['understaffed_hours']:.1f}",
        "agents_scheduled": str(f["agents"]),
        "files_changed": ",".join(files),
    }
    ratio = f["scheduled_hours"] / f["required_hours"] if f["required_hours"] else math.inf
    bound = cfg.get("max_hours_ratio")
    lines = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — weekly reconciliation, {week}", "",
             "| key | value |", "|---|---|", *[f"| {k} | {values[k]} |" for k in KEYS], "",
             f"Week checks: scheduled / required hours = {ratio:.4f}"
             + (f" (SOW §1.6 bound {bound}: {'within' if ratio <= bound + 1e-12 else 'EXCEEDED'})" if bound else "")
             + f"; weekly attainment target {cfg.get('sla_target')} per queue"
             + f" ({', '.join(f'{q} {_f3(a)}' for q, a in att.items())}).", ""]
    if note:
        lines += ["## Handover note", "", note, ""]
    (out / "RUNBOOK.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))

    target = float(cfg.get("sla_target", 0.0))
    missed = [(q, round(a, 3)) for q, a in att.items() if round(a, 3) < target]
    ex = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — SOW §2.7 exceptions, {week}", "",
          "| queue | week | achievable | shortfall |", "|---|---|---|---|",
          *[f"| {q} | {week} | {_f3(a)} | {_f3(target - a)} |" for q, a in missed], ""]
    ex.append("Targets not met with the roster provided; raised with the account team." if missed else
              f"No target missed this week: every queue's weekly attainment is at or above {target:.3f} "
              f"(SOW §1.6), so there is nothing to raise with the account team.")
    if bound and ratio > bound + 1e-12:
        ex.append(f"\nSchedule efficiency: {ratio:.4f} x required hours, above the §1.6 bound of {bound}.")
    (out / "exceptions.md").write_text("\n".join(ex) + "\n")
    return values
"""python -m wfm run --client <name> --week <YYYY-Www>"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from wfm import board, registry, weeks
from wfm.config import OUT_DIR, load_config
from wfm.evaluate.metrics import evaluate
from wfm.export import LAYOUTS, export_schedule
from wfm.export.base import check_week, read_schedule
from wfm.ingest.loader import load_week
from wfm.notify import notify_dir, write_notifications
from wfm.report import compare, history, summary, volume
from wfm.report import markdown as md
from wfm.roster import load_agents
from wfm.scheduler import greedy, greedy_v2
from wfm.scheduler.greedy import to_frame
from wfm.staffing.required import add_required


def run(client: str, week: str) -> dict:
    cfg = load_config(client)
    demand = load_week(cfg, week)
    req = add_required(demand, cfg)
    agents = load_agents(client)
    scheduler = {"greedy": greedy, "week": greedy_v2}[cfg.get("scheduler", "greedy")]
    shifts = scheduler.schedule_week(req, cfg, agents, week)
    sched = to_frame(shifts)

    out = OUT_DIR / client
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sched.to_csv(out / "schedule.csv", index=False)
    result = evaluate(req, sched, cfg, agents, week)
    (out / "eval.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    if cfg.get("reconciliation"):
        from wfm.report import reconcile   # SOW §3 RUNBOOK.md and §2.7 exceptions.md
        reconcile.write(out, cfg, week, req, sched)
    return result


# The subcommands below are off the run path: they read the registry, the data files, or what `run`
# wrote to out/. Each returns an exit code.

def _week(s: str) -> str:
    try:
        weeks.parse(s)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(str(e)) from None
    return s


def _date(s: str) -> date:
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"not a date: {s!r} (expected YYYY-MM-DD)") from None


def _out(args) -> Path:
    return Path(args.out) if getattr(args, "out", None) else OUT_DIR


def _in_range(week: str, first: str | None, last: str | None) -> bool:
    return not ((first and weeks.key(week) < weeks.key(first)) or (last and weeks.key(week) > weeks.key(last)))


def _write_report(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)
    print(text, end="")
    print(f"wrote {path}", file=sys.stderr)


def _run_outputs(client: str, week: str, out: Path):
    """Config, eval.json and schedule segments of the last run, checked to be this client-week's."""
    cfg = load_config(client)
    ev = history.read_eval(out / client / "eval.json")
    history.check_eval(ev, client, week, out / client / "eval.json")
    segments = read_schedule(out / client / "schedule.csv")
    check_week(segments, week, cfg["tz"])
    return cfg, ev, segments


def clients_cmd(args) -> int:
    reg = registry.load_registry()
    recs = list(reg.values()) if args.status is None else registry.by_status(reg, args.status)
    if args.active_on:
        recs = [r for r in registry.active_on(reg, args.active_on) if r in recs]
    if args.board:
        out = _out(args)
        if args.week:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.week}.md",
                          board.render(board.board(recs, args.week, out), args.week))
        elif args.first and args.last:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.first}_{args.last}.md",
                          board.grid(recs, args.first, args.last, out))
        else:
            raise SystemExit("--board needs --week, or --from and --to")
        return 0
    if args.timeline:
        print(registry.timeline(recs, args.until or date.today()))
        return 0
    if args.check:
        problems = [p for r in recs for p in registry.check(r, layouts=LAYOUTS, data=args.data)]
        for p in problems:
            print(p)
        n = {lvl: sum(p.level == lvl for p in problems) for lvl in (registry.ERROR, registry.WARNING, registry.PENDING)}
        print(f"{len(recs)} client(s) checked: {n['error']} error(s), {n['warning']} warning(s), {n['pending']} pending")
        return 1 if n["error"] else 0
    if args.markdown:
        print(registry.render_markdown(recs))
        return 0
    today = date.today()
    rows = [[r.key, r.status, *registry.period(r), len(r.weeks_served(today)) or md.DASH, f"{r.grain} min", r.tz,
             r.export_layout or md.DASH] for r in recs]
    print(md.text_table(["client", "status", "from", "to", "weeks", "grain", "tz", "export"], rows,
                        align="llllrrll", indent=0))
    return 0


def volume_cmd(args) -> int:
    cfg = load_config(args.client)
    rows = volume.volume_report(cfg, args.first, args.last, min_run=args.min_run)
    print(volume.render(cfg, rows, days=args.days, shape=args.profile), end="")
    if args.csv and rows:
        path = _out(args) / args.client / "reports" / f"volume_{args.first or rows[0].week}_{args.last or rows[-1].week}.csv"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(volume.to_csv(rows))
        print(f"wrote {path}", file=sys.stderr)

def archive_cmd(args) -> int:
    a = history.archive(args.client, args.week, _out(args))
    print(f"archived {args.client} {args.week} -> {a.path}" + (" (replaced)" if a.replaced else ""))

"""Evaluate a schedule.csv against the required curve: attainment, hours, constraint audit.

A convenience for engineers. Contractual evaluation is performed independently against each
client's SOW.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd

from wfm import constraints
from wfm.roster import Agent
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours


def _parse(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        df[c] = pd.to_datetime(df[c], utc=True)
    df["break_minutes"] = df["break_minutes"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return df


def coverage(sched: pd.DataFrame, grid, grain_min: int, skills: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """Per queue per interval: gross agents on queue, agents on break (overlapping the slot), and
    agents on shift on another queue who hold this queue's skill (`skills`: agent_id -> skills)."""
    gross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    on_break = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    cross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain_min)
    skills = skills or {}
    for r in sched.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                gross[r.queue][t] += 1
                for q in skills.get(r.agent_id, ()):
                    if q != r.queue:
                        cross[q][t] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    on_break[r.queue][t] += 1
    return gross, on_break, cross


def evaluate(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], week: str) -> dict:
    sched = _parse(sched)
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    gross, on_break, cross = coverage(sched, grid, grain, {a.agent_id: a.skills for a in agents})
    h = grain / 60.0
    basis = cfg.get("attainment_basis", "service_level")

    # `attainment_intervals`: `volume` (service default) counts intervals with volume; `operating`
    # counts every interval inside the queue's operating hours (`queue_hours` / `operating_hours`).
    operating = cfg.get("attainment_intervals", "volume") == "operating"
    sla, under, over = {}, 0.0, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            if operating:
                if not in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                    under += max(0, r.required - (gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc])) * h
                    continue
            elif r.volume <= 0:
                continue
            tot += 1
            scheduled = gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc]
            if basis == "coverage":   # PR #47: scheduled coverage of the requirement, capped at 1
                met += min(1.0, scheduled / r.required) if r.required else 1.0
            elif scheduled >= r.required:
                met += 1
            under += max(0, r.required - scheduled) * h
            over += max(0, scheduled - r.required) * h
        sla[q] = round(met / tot, 3) if tot else 1.0

    hours = float(((sched["segment_end_utc"] - sched["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    extra = {}
    if cfg.get("max_hours_ratio") is not None:
        req_hours = float(req["required"].sum()) * h
        extra = {"required_hours": round(req_hours, 1),
                 "hours_ratio": round(hours / req_hours, 4) if req_hours else None,
                 "max_hours_ratio": cfg["max_hours_ratio"]}
    return {
        "client": cfg["client"], "week": week, "intervals": len(grid),
        "sla": sla, "meets_target": all(v >= cfg["sla_target"] for v in sla.values()),
        "scheduled_hours": round(hours, 1),
        "understaffed_interval_hours": round(under, 1), "overstaffed_interval_hours": round(over, 1),
        "agents_scheduled": int(sched["agent_id"].nunique()),
        **extra,
        "violations": {**audit(sched, cfg, agents), "min_cover": floor_gaps(gross, cross, grid, cfg),
                       **contract_audit(sched, req, cfg, agents, gross)},
    }


def floor_gaps(gross: dict, cross: dict, grid, cfg: dict) -> int:
    """Intervals where a `min_cover` queue has less cover than its floor (see wfm/constraints.py)."""
    return sum(1 for q in (cfg.get("min_cover") or {}) for t in grid
               if constraints.cover(gross[q][t], cross[q][t], cfg) < constraints.floor(q, t, cfg))


def audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count violations of the service's standard rules per agent."""
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    v = {"weekly_hours": 0, "consecutive_days": 0, "skill_match": 0, "no_overlap": 0}
    for aid, g in sched.groupby("agent_id"):
        a = by_id.get(aid)
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        hours = ((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum()
        if a is None or hours > cfg["weekly_hours"][a.contract] + 1e-9:
            v["weekly_hours"] += 1
        if a is not None and any(q not in a.skills for q in g["queue"]):
            v["skill_match"] += 1
        ends = g["segment_end_utc"].shift(1)
        if (g["segment_start_utc"] < ends).any():
            v["no_overlap"] += 1
        days = sorted({t.astimezone(z).date() for t in g["segment_start_utc"]})
        run = 1
        for d1, d2 in zip(days, days[1:]):
            run = run + 1 if (d2 - d1).days == 1 else 1
            if run > cfg["max_consecutive_days"]:
                v["consecutive_days"] += 1
                break
    return v


def _shifts(sched: pd.DataFrame, z: ZoneInfo) -> list[dict]:
    """Segments grouped into shifts: one shift per agent per local day."""
    out = []
    for (aid, day), g in sched.groupby([sched["agent_id"], sched["segment_start_utc"].map(lambda t: t.astimezone(z).date())]):
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        out.append({"agent_id": aid, "day": day, "queue": g["queue"].iloc[0],
                    "start": g["segment_start_utc"].iloc[0], "end": g["segment_end_utc"].iloc[-1],
                    "segments": list(zip(g["segment_start_utc"], g["segment_end_utc"])),
                    "hours": float((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds().sum() / 3600),
                    "breaks": [(b, int(m)) for b, m in zip(g["break_start_utc"], g["break_minutes"]) if m and pd.notna(b)]})
    return out


def contract_audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, req: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], gross: dict) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Rules from the newer contracts, audited only for clients whose config turns them on:
    `min_rest_hours` (rest), `split_contracts` (split_shift), `break.placement: surplus` (breaks:
    count, length, window, and the interval with the largest gross surplus)."""
    v: dict[str, int] = {}
    if sched.empty:
        return v
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    shifts = _shifts(sched, z)
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    if cfg.get("min_rest_hours"):
        rest = timedelta(hours=float(cfg["min_rest_hours"]))
        v["rest"] = 0
        for aid in {s["agent_id"] for s in shifts}:
            mine = sorted((s for s in shifts if s["agent_id"] == aid), key=lambda s: s["start"])
            v["rest"] += sum(1 for a, b in zip(mine, mine[1:]) if b["start"] - a["end"] < rest)
    if cfg.get("split_contracts") is not None:
        ok = set(cfg["split_contracts"])
        v["split_shift"] = sum(1 for s in shifts if len(s["segments"]) > 1
                               and (s["agent_id"] not in by_id or by_id[s["agent_id"]].contract not in ok))
    rule = cfg.get("break") or {}
    if rule.get("placement") == "surplus":
        grain = timedelta(minutes=cfg["interval_minutes"])
        required = {(r.queue, r.interval_start_utc): int(r.required) for r in req.itertuples(index=False)}
        lo, hi = (timedelta(hours=x) for x in rule["window_hours"])
        length = timedelta(minutes=rule["minutes"])
        bad = 0
        for s in shifts:
            if s["hours"] < rule["min_shift_hours"]:
                bad += bool(s["breaks"])
                continue
            if len(s["breaks"]) != 1 or s["breaks"][0][1] != rule["minutes"]:
                bad += 1
                continue
            b = s["breaks"][0][0]
            if not (s["start"] + lo <= b <= s["start"] + hi) or not any(a <= b and b + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"]):
                bad += 1
                continue
            slot = [t for t in required if t[0] == s["queue"] and t[1] <= b < t[1] + grain]
            if not slot or b + length > slot[0][1] + grain:
                bad += 1
                continue
            q = s["queue"]
            window = [t for (qq, t) in required if qq == q and s["start"] + lo <= t <= s["start"] + hi
                      and any(a <= t and t + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"])]
            surplus = lambda t: gross[q][t] - required[(q, t)]
            if window and surplus(slot[0][1]) < max(surplus(t) for t in window):
                bad += 1
        v["breaks"] = bad
    return v
"""Weekly reconciliation report (Northwind SOW §3) and the exceptions file (SOW §2.7).

Written by `run` for clients whose config sets `reconciliation`:

    reconciliation:
      handover: docs/clients/northwind.md   # handover note: sections `## Handover note` and `## Files changed`

Every figure is recomputed here from the run's own required curve and schedule (not copied from the
evaluator), with the SOW definitions: attainment over each queue's operating intervals, met when the
agents on the queue net of breaks are at least the Erlang C requirement; hours elapsed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from wfm.config import APP_DIR
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours

KEYS = ("intervals_in_week", "sla_attainment_priority", "sla_attainment_standard", "sla_attainment_vip",
        "scheduled_hours_total", "required_hours_total", "understaffed_interval_hours", "agents_scheduled",
        "files_changed")


def figures(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict) -> dict:
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain)
    h = grain / 60.0
    s = sched.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        s[c] = pd.to_datetime(s[c], utc=True)
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    net = defaultdict(int)
    for r in s.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                net[(r.queue, t)] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and pd.notna(r.break_start_utc) and \
                        r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    net[(r.queue, t)] -= 1
    attainment, under = {}, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            n = net[(q, r.interval_start_utc)]
            under += max(0, int(r.required) - n) * h
            if in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                tot += 1
                met += n >= int(r.required)
        attainment[q] = met / tot if tot else 1.0
    hours = float(((s["segment_end_utc"] - s["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    return {"intervals": len(grid), "attainment": attainment, "scheduled_hours": hours,
            "required_hours": float(req["required"].sum()) * h, "understaffed_hours": under,
            "agents": int(s["agent_id"].nunique())}


def _handover(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """(handover note markdown, files changed) from the client's handover document."""
    text = path.read_text()
    note = re.search(r"^## Handover note\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    files = re.search(r"^## Files changed\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    paths = re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)`", files.group(1), re.M) if files else []
    return (note.group(1).strip() if note else ""), paths


def _f3(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.3f}"


def write(out: Path, cfg: dict, week: str, req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    spec = cfg.get("reconciliation") or {}
    f = figures(req, sched, cfg)
    note, files = _handover(APP_DIR / spec["handover"]) if spec.get("handover") else ("", [])
    att = f["attainment"]
    values = {
        "intervals_in_week": str(f["intervals"]),
        **{f"sla_attainment_{q}": _f3(att.get(q, float("nan"))) for q in ("priority", "standard", "vip")},
        "scheduled_hours_total": f"{f['scheduled_hours']:.1f}",
        "required_hours_total": f"{f['required_hours']:.1f}",
        "understaffed_interval_hours": f"{f['understaffed_hours']:.1f}",
        "agents_scheduled": str(f["agents"]),
        "files_changed": ",".join(files),
    }
    ratio = f["scheduled_hours"] / f["required_hours"] if f["required_hours"] else math.inf
    bound = cfg.get("max_hours_ratio")
    lines = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — weekly reconciliation, {week}", "",
             "| key | value |", "|---|---|", *[f"| {k} | {values[k]} |" for k in KEYS], "",
             f"Week checks: scheduled / required hours = {ratio:.4f}"
             + (f" (SOW §1.6 bound {bound}: {'within' if ratio <= bound + 1e-12 else 'EXCEEDED'})" if bound else "")
             + f"; weekly attainment target {cfg.get('sla_target')} per queue"
             + f" ({', '.join(f'{q} {_f3(a)}' for q, a in att.items())}).", ""]
    if note:
        lines += ["## Handover note", "", note, ""]
    (out / "RUNBOOK.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))

    target = float(cfg.get("sla_target", 0.0))
    missed = [(q, round(a, 3)) for q, a in att.items() if round(a, 3) < target]
    ex = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — SOW §2.7 exceptions, {week}", "",
          "| queue | week | achievable | shortfall |", "|---|---|---|---|",
          *[f"| {q} | {week} | {_f3(a)} | {_f3(target - a)} |" for q, a in missed], ""]
    ex.append("Targets not met with the roster provided; raised with the account team." if missed else
              f"No target missed this week: every queue's weekly attainment is at or above {target:.3f} "
              f"(SOW §1.6), so there is nothing to raise with the account team.")
    if bound and ratio > bound + 1e-12:
        ex.append(f"\nSchedule efficiency: {ratio:.4f} x required hours, above the §1.6 bound of {bound}.")
    (out / "exceptions.md").write_text("\n".join(ex) + "\n")
    return values
"""python -m wfm run --client <name> --week <YYYY-Www>"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from wfm import board, registry, weeks
from wfm.config import OUT_DIR, load_config
from wfm.evaluate.metrics import evaluate
from wfm.export import LAYOUTS, export_schedule
from wfm.export.base import check_week, read_schedule
from wfm.ingest.loader import load_week
from wfm.notify import notify_dir, write_notifications
from wfm.report import compare, history, summary, volume
from wfm.report import markdown as md
from wfm.roster import load_agents
from wfm.scheduler import greedy, greedy_v2
from wfm.scheduler.greedy import to_frame
from wfm.staffing.required import add_required


def run(client: str, week: str) -> dict:
    cfg = load_config(client)
    demand = load_week(cfg, week)
    req = add_required(demand, cfg)
    agents = load_agents(client)
    scheduler = {"greedy": greedy, "week": greedy_v2}[cfg.get("scheduler", "greedy")]
    shifts = scheduler.schedule_week(req, cfg, agents, week)
    sched = to_frame(shifts)

    out = OUT_DIR / client
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sched.to_csv(out / "schedule.csv", index=False)
    result = evaluate(req, sched, cfg, agents, week)
    (out / "eval.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    if cfg.get("reconciliation"):
        from wfm.report import reconcile   # SOW §3 RUNBOOK.md and §2.7 exceptions.md
        reconcile.write(out, cfg, week, req, sched)
    return result


# The subcommands below are off the run path: they read the registry, the data files, or what `run`
# wrote to out/. Each returns an exit code.

def _week(s: str) -> str:
    try:
        weeks.parse(s)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(str(e)) from None
    return s


def _date(s: str) -> date:
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"not a date: {s!r} (expected YYYY-MM-DD)") from None


def _out(args) -> Path:
    return Path(args.out) if getattr(args, "out", None) else OUT_DIR


def _in_range(week: str, first: str | None, last: str | None) -> bool:
    return not ((first and weeks.key(week) < weeks.key(first)) or (last and weeks.key(week) > weeks.key(last)))


def _write_report(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)
    print(text, end="")
    print(f"wrote {path}", file=sys.stderr)


def _run_outputs(client: str, week: str, out: Path):
    """Config, eval.json and schedule segments of the last run, checked to be this client-week's."""
    cfg = load_config(client)
    ev = history.read_eval(out / client / "eval.json")
    history.check_eval(ev, client, week, out / client / "eval.json")
    segments = read_schedule(out / client / "schedule.csv")
    check_week(segments, week, cfg["tz"])
    return cfg, ev, segments


def clients_cmd(args) -> int:
    reg = registry.load_registry()
    recs = list(reg.values()) if args.status is None else registry.by_status(reg, args.status)
    if args.active_on:
        recs = [r for r in registry.active_on(reg, args.active_on) if r in recs]
    if args.board:
        out = _out(args)
        if args.week:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.week}.md",
                          board.render(board.board(recs, args.week, out), args.week))
        elif args.first and args.last:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.first}_{args.last}.md",
                          board.grid(recs, args.first, args.last, out))
        else:
            raise SystemExit("--board needs --week, or --from and --to")
        return 0
    if args.timeline:
        print(registry.timeline(recs, args.until or date.today()))
        return 0
    if args.check:
        problems = [p for r in recs for p in registry.check(r, layouts=LAYOUTS, data=args.data)]
        for p in problems:
            print(p)
        n = {lvl: sum(p.level == lvl for p in problems) for lvl in (registry.ERROR, registry.WARNING, registry.PENDING)}
        print(f"{len(recs)} client(s) checked: {n['error']} error(s), {n['warning']} warning(s), {n['pending']} pending")
        return 1 if n["error"] else 0
    if args.markdown:
        print(registry.render_markdown(recs))
        return 0
    today = date.today()
    rows = [[r.key, r.status, *registry.period(r), len(r.weeks_served(today)) or md.DASH, f"{r.grain} min", r.tz,
             r.export_layout or md.DASH] for r in recs]
    print(md.text_table(["client", "status", "from", "to", "weeks", "grain", "tz", "export"], rows,
                        align="llllrrll", indent=0))
    return 0


def volume_cmd(args) -> int:
    cfg = load_config(args.client)
    rows = volume.volume_report(cfg, args.first, args.last, min_run=args.min_run)
    print(volume.render(cfg, rows, days=args.days, shape=args.profile), end="")

"""Evaluate a schedule.csv against the required curve: attainment, hours, constraint audit.

A convenience for engineers. Contractual evaluation is performed independently against each
client's SOW.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

import pandas as pd

from wfm import constraints
from wfm.roster import Agent
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours


def _parse(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        df[c] = pd.to_datetime(df[c], utc=True)
    df["break_minutes"] = df["break_minutes"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return df


def coverage(sched: pd.DataFrame, grid, grain_min: int, skills: dict | None = None) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """Per queue per interval: gross agents on queue, agents on break (overlapping the slot), and
    agents on shift on another queue who hold this queue's skill (`skills`: agent_id -> skills)."""
    gross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    on_break = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    cross = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain_min)
    skills = skills or {}
    for r in sched.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                gross[r.queue][t] += 1
                for q in skills.get(r.agent_id, ()):
                    if q != r.queue:
                        cross[q][t] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    on_break[r.queue][t] += 1
    return gross, on_break, cross


def evaluate(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], week: str) -> dict:
    sched = _parse(sched)
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    gross, on_break, cross = coverage(sched, grid, grain, {a.agent_id: a.skills for a in agents})
    h = grain / 60.0
    basis = cfg.get("attainment_basis", "service_level")

    # `attainment_intervals`: `volume` (service default) counts intervals with volume; `operating`
    # counts every interval inside the queue's operating hours (`queue_hours` / `operating_hours`).
    operating = cfg.get("attainment_intervals", "volume") == "operating"
    sla, under, over = {}, 0.0, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            if operating:
                if not in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                    under += max(0, r.required - (gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc])) * h
                    continue
            elif r.volume <= 0:
                continue
            tot += 1
            scheduled = gross[q][r.interval_start_utc] - on_break[q][r.interval_start_utc]
            if basis == "coverage":   # PR #47: scheduled coverage of the requirement, capped at 1
                met += min(1.0, scheduled / r.required) if r.required else 1.0
            elif scheduled >= r.required:
                met += 1
            under += max(0, r.required - scheduled) * h
            over += max(0, scheduled - r.required) * h
        sla[q] = round(met / tot, 3) if tot else 1.0

    hours = float(((sched["segment_end_utc"] - sched["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    extra = {}
    if cfg.get("max_hours_ratio") is not None:
        req_hours = float(req["required"].sum()) * h
        extra = {"required_hours": round(req_hours, 1),
                 "hours_ratio": round(hours / req_hours, 4) if req_hours else None,
                 "max_hours_ratio": cfg["max_hours_ratio"]}
    return {
        "client": cfg["client"], "week": week, "intervals": len(grid),
        "sla": sla, "meets_target": all(v >= cfg["sla_target"] for v in sla.values()),
        "scheduled_hours": round(hours, 1),
        "understaffed_interval_hours": round(under, 1), "overstaffed_interval_hours": round(over, 1),
        "agents_scheduled": int(sched["agent_id"].nunique()),
        **extra,
        "violations": {**audit(sched, cfg, agents), "min_cover": floor_gaps(gross, cross, grid, cfg),
                       **contract_audit(sched, req, cfg, agents, gross)},
    }


def floor_gaps(gross: dict, cross: dict, grid, cfg: dict) -> int:
    """Intervals where a `min_cover` queue has less cover than its floor (see wfm/constraints.py)."""
    return sum(1 for q in (cfg.get("min_cover") or {}) for t in grid
               if constraints.cover(gross[q][t], cross[q][t], cfg) < constraints.floor(q, t, cfg))


def audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Count violations of the service's standard rules per agent."""
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    v = {"weekly_hours": 0, "consecutive_days": 0, "skill_match": 0, "no_overlap": 0}
    for aid, g in sched.groupby("agent_id"):
        a = by_id.get(aid)
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        hours = ((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum()
        if a is None or hours > cfg["weekly_hours"][a.contract] + 1e-9:
            v["weekly_hours"] += 1
        if a is not None and any(q not in a.skills for q in g["queue"]):
            v["skill_match"] += 1
        ends = g["segment_end_utc"].shift(1)
        if (g["segment_start_utc"] < ends).any():
            v["no_overlap"] += 1
        days = sorted({t.astimezone(z).date() for t in g["segment_start_utc"]})
        run = 1
        for d1, d2 in zip(days, days[1:]):
            run = run + 1 if (d2 - d1).days == 1 else 1
            if run > cfg["max_consecutive_days"]:
                v["consecutive_days"] += 1
                break
    return v


def _shifts(sched: pd.DataFrame, z: ZoneInfo) -> list[dict]:
    """Segments grouped into shifts: one shift per agent per local day."""
    out = []
    for (aid, day), g in sched.groupby([sched["agent_id"], sched["segment_start_utc"].map(lambda t: t.astimezone(z).date())]):
        g = g.sort_values("segment_start_utc")
        out.append({"agent_id": aid, "day": day, "queue": g["queue"].iloc[0],
                    "start": g["segment_start_utc"].iloc[0], "end": g["segment_end_utc"].iloc[-1],
                    "segments": list(zip(g["segment_start_utc"], g["segment_end_utc"])),
                    "hours": float((g["segment_end_utc"] - g["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds().sum() / 3600),
                    "breaks": [(b, int(m)) for b, m in zip(g["break_start_utc"], g["break_minutes"]) if m and pd.notna(b)]})
    return out


def contract_audit(sched: pd.DataFrame, req: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict, agents: list[Agent], gross: dict) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Rules from the newer contracts, audited only for clients whose config turns them on:
    `min_rest_hours` (rest), `split_contracts` (split_shift), `break.placement: surplus` (breaks:
    count, length, window, and the interval with the largest gross surplus)."""
    v: dict[str, int] = {}
    if sched.empty:
        return v
    z = ZoneInfo(cfg["tz"])
    shifts = _shifts(sched, z)
    by_id = {a.agent_id: a for a in agents}
    if cfg.get("min_rest_hours"):
        rest = timedelta(hours=float(cfg["min_rest_hours"]))
        v["rest"] = 0
        for aid in {s["agent_id"] for s in shifts}:
            mine = sorted((s for s in shifts if s["agent_id"] == aid), key=lambda s: s["start"])
            v["rest"] += sum(1 for a, b in zip(mine, mine[1:]) if b["start"] - a["end"] < rest)
    if cfg.get("split_contracts") is not None:
        ok = set(cfg["split_contracts"])
        v["split_shift"] = sum(1 for s in shifts if len(s["segments"]) > 1
                               and (s["agent_id"] not in by_id or by_id[s["agent_id"]].contract not in ok))
    rule = cfg.get("break") or {}
    if rule.get("placement") == "surplus":
        grain = timedelta(minutes=cfg["interval_minutes"])
        required = {(r.queue, r.interval_start_utc): int(r.required) for r in req.itertuples(index=False)}
        lo, hi = (timedelta(hours=x) for x in rule["window_hours"])
        length = timedelta(minutes=rule["minutes"])
        bad = 0
        for s in shifts:
            if s["hours"] < rule["min_shift_hours"]:
                bad += bool(s["breaks"])
                continue
            if len(s["breaks"]) != 1 or s["breaks"][0][1] != rule["minutes"]:
                bad += 1
                continue
            b = s["breaks"][0][0]
            if not (s["start"] + lo <= b <= s["start"] + hi) or not any(a <= b and b + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"]):
                bad += 1
                continue
            slot = [t for t in required if t[0] == s["queue"] and t[1] <= b < t[1] + grain]
            if not slot or b + length > slot[0][1] + grain:
                bad += 1
                continue
            q = s["queue"]
            window = [t for (qq, t) in required if qq == q and s["start"] + lo <= t <= s["start"] + hi
                      and any(a <= t and t + length <= e for a, e in s["segments"])]
            surplus = lambda t: gross[q][t] - required[(q, t)]
            if window and surplus(slot[0][1]) < max(surplus(t) for t in window):
                bad += 1
        v["breaks"] = bad
    return v
"""Weekly reconciliation report (Northwind SOW §3) and the exceptions file (SOW §2.7).

Written by `run` for clients whose config sets `reconciliation`:

    reconciliation:
      handover: docs/clients/northwind.md   # handover note: sections `## Handover note` and `## Files changed`

Every figure is recomputed here from the run's own required curve and schedule (not copied from the
evaluator), with the SOW definitions: attainment over each queue's operating intervals, met when the
agents on the queue net of breaks are at least the Erlang C requirement; hours elapsed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from wfm.config import APP_DIR
from wfm.staffing.required import in_hours

KEYS = ("intervals_in_week", "sla_attainment_priority", "sla_attainment_standard", "sla_attainment_vip",
        "scheduled_hours_total", "required_hours_total", "understaffed_interval_hours", "agents_scheduled",
        "files_changed")


def figures(req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame, cfg: dict) -> dict:
    grain = cfg["interval_minutes"]
    step = timedelta(minutes=grain)
    h = grain / 60.0
    s = sched.copy()
    for c in ("segment_start_utc", "segment_end_utc", "break_start_utc"):
        s[c] = pd.to_datetime(s[c], utc=True)
    grid = sorted(set(req["interval_start_utc"]))
    net = defaultdict(int)
    for r in s.itertuples(index=False):
        for t in grid:
            if r.segment_start_utc <= t < r.segment_end_utc:
                net[(r.queue, t)] += 1
                if r.break_minutes and pd.notna(r.break_start_utc) and \
                        r.break_start_utc < t + step and t < r.break_start_utc + timedelta(minutes=int(r.break_minutes)):
                    net[(r.queue, t)] -= 1
    attainment, under = {}, 0.0
    for q, g in req.groupby("queue", sort=False):
        met = tot = 0
        for r in g.itertuples(index=False):
            n = net[(q, r.interval_start_utc)]
            under += max(0, int(r.required) - n) * h
            if in_hours(r.interval_start_utc, cfg, q):
                tot += 1
                met += n >= int(r.required)
        attainment[q] = met / tot if tot else 1.0
    hours = float(((s["segment_end_utc"] - s["segment_start_utc"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600).sum())
    return {"intervals": len(grid), "attainment": attainment, "scheduled_hours": hours,
            "required_hours": float(req["required"].sum()) * h, "understaffed_hours": under,
            "agents": int(s["agent_id"].nunique())}


def _handover(path: Path) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """(handover note markdown, files changed) from the client's handover document."""
    text = path.read_text()
    note = re.search(r"^## Handover note\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    files = re.search(r"^## Files changed\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.S | re.M)
    paths = re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)`", files.group(1), re.M) if files else []
    return (note.group(1).strip() if note else ""), paths


def _f3(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.3f}"


def write(out: Path, cfg: dict, week: str, req: pd.DataFrame, sched: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    spec = cfg.get("reconciliation") or {}
    f = figures(req, sched, cfg)
    note, files = _handover(APP_DIR / spec["handover"]) if spec.get("handover") else ("", [])
    att = f["attainment"]
    values = {
        "intervals_in_week": str(f["intervals"]),
        **{f"sla_attainment_{q}": _f3(att.get(q, float("nan"))) for q in ("priority", "standard", "vip")},
        "scheduled_hours_total": f"{f['scheduled_hours']:.1f}",
        "required_hours_total": f"{f['required_hours']:.1f}",
        "understaffed_interval_hours": f"{f['understaffed_hours']:.1f}",
        "agents_scheduled": str(f["agents"]),
        "files_changed": ",".join(files),
    }
    ratio = f["scheduled_hours"] / f["required_hours"] if f["required_hours"] else math.inf
    bound = cfg.get("max_hours_ratio")
    lines = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — weekly reconciliation, {week}", "",
             "| key | value |", "|---|---|", *[f"| {k} | {values[k]} |" for k in KEYS], "",
             f"Week checks: scheduled / required hours = {ratio:.4f}"
             + (f" (SOW §1.6 bound {bound}: {'within' if ratio <= bound + 1e-12 else 'EXCEEDED'})" if bound else "")
             + f"; weekly attainment target {cfg.get('sla_target')} per queue"
             + f" ({', '.join(f'{q} {_f3(a)}' for q, a in att.items())}).", ""]
    if note:
        lines += ["## Handover note", "", note, ""]
    (out / "RUNBOOK.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))

    target = float(cfg.get("sla_target", 0.0))
    missed = [(q, round(a, 3)) for q, a in att.items() if round(a, 3) < target]
    ex = [f"# {cfg.get('name', cfg['client'])} — SOW §2.7 exceptions, {week}", "",
          "| queue | week | achievable | shortfall |", "|---|---|---|---|",
          *[f"| {q} | {week} | {_f3(a)} | {_f3(target - a)} |" for q, a in missed], ""]
    ex.append("Targets not met with the roster provided; raised with the account team." if missed else
              f"No target missed this week: every queue's weekly attainment is at or above {target:.3f} "
              f"(SOW §1.6), so there is nothing to raise with the account team.")
    if bound and ratio > bound + 1e-12:
        ex.append(f"\nSchedule efficiency: {ratio:.4f} x required hours, above the §1.6 bound of {bound}.")
    (out / "exceptions.md").write_text("\n".join(ex) + "\n")
    return values
"""python -m wfm run --client <name> --week <YYYY-Www>"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from wfm import board, registry, weeks
from wfm.config import OUT_DIR, load_config
from wfm.evaluate.metrics import evaluate
from wfm.export import LAYOUTS, export_schedule
from wfm.export.base import check_week, read_schedule
from wfm.ingest.loader import load_week
from wfm.notify import notify_dir, write_notifications
from wfm.report import compare, history, summary, volume
from wfm.report import markdown as md
from wfm.roster import load_agents
from wfm.scheduler import greedy, greedy_v2
from wfm.scheduler.greedy import to_frame
from wfm.staffing.required import add_required


def run(client: str, week: str) -> dict:
    cfg = load_config(client)
    demand = load_week(cfg, week)
    req = add_required(demand, cfg)
    agents = load_agents(client)
    scheduler = {"greedy": greedy, "week": greedy_v2}[cfg.get("scheduler", "greedy")]
    shifts = scheduler.schedule_week(req, cfg, agents, week)
    sched = to_frame(shifts)

    out = OUT_DIR / client
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    sched.to_csv(out / "schedule.csv", index=False)
    result = evaluate(req, sched, cfg, agents, week)
    (out / "eval.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    if cfg.get("reconciliation"):
        from wfm.report import reconcile   # SOW §3 RUNBOOK.md and §2.7 exceptions.md
        reconcile.write(out, cfg, week, req, sched)
    return result


# The subcommands below are off the run path: they read the registry, the data files, or what `run`
# wrote to out/. Each returns an exit code.

def _week(s: str) -> str:
    try:
        weeks.parse(s)
    except ValueError as e:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(str(e)) from None
    return s


def _date(s: str) -> date:
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(s)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"not a date: {s!r} (expected YYYY-MM-DD)") from None


def _out(args) -> Path:
    return Path(args.out) if getattr(args, "out", None) else OUT_DIR


def _in_range(week: str, first: str | None, last: str | None) -> bool:
    return not ((first and weeks.key(week) < weeks.key(first)) or (last and weeks.key(week) > weeks.key(last)))


def _write_report(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text)
    print(text, end="")
    print(f"wrote {path}", file=sys.stderr)


def _run_outputs(client: str, week: str, out: Path):
    """Config, eval.json and schedule segments of the last run, checked to be this client-week's."""
    cfg = load_config(client)
    ev = history.read_eval(out / client / "eval.json")
    history.check_eval(ev, client, week, out / client / "eval.json")
    segments = read_schedule(out / client / "schedule.csv")
    check_week(segments, week, cfg["tz"])
    return cfg, ev, segments


def clients_cmd(args) -> int:
    reg = registry.load_registry()
    recs = list(reg.values()) if args.status is None else registry.by_status(reg, args.status)
    if args.active_on:
        recs = [r for r in registry.active_on(reg, args.active_on) if r in recs]
    if args.board:
        out = _out(args)
        if args.week:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.week}.md",
                          board.render(board.board(recs, args.week, out), args.week))
        elif args.first and args.last:
            _write_report(out / "reports" / f"board_{args.first}_{args.last}.md",
                          board.grid(recs, args.first, args.last, out))
        else:
            raise SystemExit("--board needs --week, or --from and --to")
        return 0
    if args.timeline:
        print(registry.timeline(recs, args.until or date.today()))
        return 0
    if args.check:
        problems = [p for r in recs for p in registry.check(r, layouts=LAYOUTS, data=args.data)]
        for p in problems:
            print(p)
        n = {lvl: sum(p.level == lvl for p in problems) for lvl in (registry.ERROR, registry.WARNING, registry.PENDING)}
        print(f"{len(recs)} client(s) checked: {n['error']} error(s), {n['warning']} warning(s), {n['pending']} pending")
        return 1 if n["error"] else 0
    if args.markdown:
        print(registry.render_markdown(recs))
        return 0
    today = date.today()
    rows = [[r.key, r.status, *registry.period(r), len(r.weeks_served(today)) or md.DASH, f"{r.grain} min", r.tz,
             r.export_layout or md.DASH] for r in recs]
    print(md.text_table(["client", "status", "from", "to", "weeks", "grain", "tz", "export"], rows,
                        align="llllrrll", indent=0))
    return 0


def volume_cmd(args) -> int:
    cfg = load_config(args.client)
    rows = volume.volume_report(cfg, args.first, args.last, min_run=args.min_run)
    print(volume.render(cfg, rows, days=args.days, shape=args.profile), end="")
    if args.csv and rows:
        path = _out(args) / args.client / "reports" / f"volume_{args.first or rows[0].week}_{args.last or rows[-1].week}.csv"
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(volume.to_csv(rows))
        print(f"wrote {path}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


def archive_cmd(args) -> int:
    a = history.archive(args.client, args.week, _out(args))
    print(f"archived {args.client} {args.week} -> {a.path}" + (" (replaced)" if a.replaced else ""))
    return 0
